last_action_summary.value: Affirmed BBB- / A-3 and revised outlook to Stable from Negative citing improving 737 MAX and 787 production stability.
Affirmed Baa3 senior unsecured / P-3 commercial paper and revised outlook to Stable from Negative following Spirit AeroSystems acquisition close (Dec 8, 2025) and liquidity/quality improvements.
Affirmed BBB- Long-Term IDR / F3 Short-Term IDR and revised outlook to Positive from Stable citing durable 737 MAX and 787 recovery, gross debt reduction, and inflecting positive FCF.
